chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Allah has not purified a hand in which there is an iron ring."

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One who grants purification
key_terms.حَدِيدٍ: iron; the material of the ring mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.حَلْقَةُ: a ring; a circular ornament worn on the hand
key_terms.يَدًا: a hand; the limb described as affected by the ruling

ai.seo_question: Does wearing an iron ring affect ritual purity or salat (prayer) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a hand wearing an iron ring is not regarded as purified by Allah. In context, it relates to legal rulings on what may be worn, especially in connection with ritual purity and salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Allah (swt) has not purified a hand that wears an iron ring."
